Ravindra Jadeja Asks About Selector Role After Ajit Agarkar's Departure

Cricketer Ravindra Jadeja has publicly inquired about the process of applying for a selector position following the departure of Ajit Agarkar. Jadeja reportedly asked how to apply for the role, with the timing of his question coinciding with Agarkar's exit. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has expressed gratitude to Ajit Agarkar, listing his achievements.
